columns.text: Exports, imports and balance of trade 2015-2026

comments.comment: The Fob (Free on board) value means the price for the item when it is on board whatever means of transport in the country of export.
CIF (Cost, Insurance, Freight) value means the Fob value plus costs induced until the item is unloaded in the country of import. This chiefly involves freight rates and insurance costs.
